snippet.title: The Shadows Of Eldergroove: Official Trailer. | A Horror Game Built By A Solo Dev On 4GB RAM.
snippet.description:
The Shadows Of Eldergroove is out now! Hope so you enjoy the trailer. 

Add to your collection on itch.io: https://fresterous-studios.itch.io/the-shadows-of-eldergroove

20 years have passed since Agent Rebecca went missing.

The Fresterous Police Department gave up and the world moved on. But Sarah, the daughter of the lead investigator, refuses to let the mystery rest. Firing up her car, she arrives in Eldergroove, a forsaken place where an entire town vanished without a trace.

Is she alone?
